messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started -> env: dev-sandbox, tag: v1.13.0-devpatch, commit: abc1234, canary: 20%, change-window: 15m
maria.king: noted. is feature_flag:recommend_v2 enabled for sandbox services?
deploy-bot: feature_flag recommend_v2 preserved from previous config for this deploy.
jonathan: seeing a small bump in 5xxs on /api/generate (pod-3) after the first batch. low volume but consistent.
lee: grabbing logs, sending grep now. could be a model weight mismatch with the quantized path.
priya: if 5xx persists we should abort canary and pin back to last-green (def5678). change window ok to extend?
sasha.b: agreed. starting healthcheck sweep across canary subset. will report errors count.
deploy-bot: Healthcheck: /api/generate 5xx_count=7, latency_p50 +120ms relative baseline. Canary traffic throttled to 10% during checks.
jonathan: 7 errors in first 10m. not huge but it's trending. recommend aborting canary and running partial rollback to main commit def5678.
maria.king: +1 to rollback. Also flagging that recommend_v2 toggle might be incompatible with v1.13 quantization changes. Need a config pin.
deploy-bot: Initiating abort: canary rollback to commit def5678. Pinning service image to def5678 in rollout config.
sasha.b: rollback task started. removing canary routers from 2/2 nodes (10% each).
deploy-bot: rollback progress: 2/2 nodes updated, traffic routed back to def5678. All healthchecks passing.
lee: logs after rollback show error rate back to baseline. looks clean.
priya: ok let's keep v1.13.0-devpatch out of dev-sandbox for now. Open an issue to validate quantized path + feature flag compatibility.
maria.king: created issue INF-3247 and linked the failing traces. Also pinned image in deploy config to def5678 to avoid accidental re-deploys.
deploy-bot: Deploy aborted and rollback complete. Final state: env dev-sandbox -> commit def5678 (pinned), change-window closed early.
jonathan: thanks all. follow-up: schedule a small test deploy to a sandbox node after fixes, do a canary with 5% and a smoke-suite.
sasha.b: adding a quick checklist to INF-3247 for reproduce steps + smoke commands.
maria.king: closing loop here. good catch on the flag mismatch. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Notification: team action items - INF-3247 (investigate quant path), keep pinned commit def5678 until confirmed.
